chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The white rooster is my friend and a friend of every believer.

key_terms.الدِّيكُ الْأَبْيَضُ: The white rooster — a bird traditionally regarded as spiritually significant in Islamic tradition for its crowing at dawn, signaling the time for Fajr prayer
key_terms.صَدِيقِي: My friend — the Imam's personal claim of friendship with the white rooster, indicating its special spiritual status
key_terms.مُؤْمِن: Believer — a Muslim who has sincere faith (iman) in their heart

ai.seo_question: Why is the white rooster considered a friend of believers in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms a special spiritual bond between the white rooster and believers, attributing personal friendship to this bird. In classical Islamic tradition, the rooster was considered a spiritually significant creature due to its habit of crowing before the dawn prayer, and white coloring was often associated with purity and blessing. This brief statement from the sixth Imam elevates the status of the white rooster and encourages believers to regard it with affection and respect.
